cross_cutting.why_it_matters: Every item routed to the Architect lands on Moriarty acting in the Architect capacity. Approved ADRs record the Decision Owner as 'Architect (Founder)', and GDR-0028 records 'Founder / Architect: Moriarty'. The equivalence is implied, not ratified. items.question: May the canonical PD-03 Volume 3 and PD-04 Volume 4 become resident, and by what act?
established_facts: Both volumes exist and were verified by direct read in a P10-era session path. Volume 3: 8 Part files, A1–H10, 80/80 section identities, 3,704,607 bytes. Volume 4: 3 Part files, A1–C10, 30/30 identities, 1,508,896 bytes, matching ACT-CC-P6-071 §2 to the byte.
They were never committed. On 2026-09-26, over the full (unshallowed) history of every branch, `git rev-list --objects --all` finds no volume-3 or volume-4 object.
They are not in this container: the filesystem and upload paths were searched on 2026-09-26, and /mnt/user-data/working is empty.
ACT-CC-P12-023 attempted supply on 2026-09-18 and found the volumes unreachable from any execution environment. The session path did not survive its session.
Residency is conferred only by Founder supply under a named Act (E-29). The PD-02 precedent needed three things: a Founder transmission, a named authorizing Act, and a namespace decision (ADR-0012).
Volume 3's own closure record approves terminality (Successor Architecture: NOT FOUND). No successor artifact supersedes either volume.
